g.title: cluster_driver
g.text: DRIVER process (furiosa-llm build — 1 process, ~120 threads, parked on ray.get during the build)

g.title: cluster_w1
g.text: RAY WORKER 1 — ray::LocalPipelineGenerationActor (@ray.remote num_cpus=24) — TRACE + PARTITION + PARALLELIZE

g.title: cluster_w2
g.text: RAY WORKER 2 — ray::TaskCompileActor (@ray.remote num_cpus=32) — COMPILE (EDF blobs)

g.title: cluster_native
g.text: NATIVE — native_llm_common.cpython-312*.so (143MB, STRIPPED; PyO3 furiosa.native_common.compiler) + furiosa_torch_ext

g.title: n_compile
g.text: compiler.compile ★ AOT COMPILE → EDF / precommand blob

g.title: k_none
g.text: no /dev/rngd open · 0 doorbell/DMA/ioctl (build is pure host CPU)

g.text: (host CPU only — never reaches the NPU)
